svg.title: Home latency over time: router vs internet
svg.desc: Recorded checks from Oct 07 14:47 to Oct 12 02:05, UTC-04:00. Gateway ICMP and external TCP handshake medians are different probes. Shaded bands mark sustained external latency increases; these observations do not confirm the cause or rule out Wi-Fi.
svg.text: Home latency observations; the cause remains unconfirmed
1238 checks · Oct 07 14:47 to Oct 12 02:05 UTC-04:00 · medians capped at 300 ms
ICMP/TCP probes differ; shading marks observations, not a confirmed cause.
